gloss: to assume; to suppose; to envision

definitions.gloss: to assume, to suppose, to envision, to hypothesize
definitions.explanation: To consider a particular situation or scenario as a possibility, especially for planning or preparation purposes. Common in formal, technical, and disaster-preparedness contexts.

examples.japanese: {最悪|さいあく}の{事態|じたい}を{想定|そうてい}する。
{想定|そうてい}していなかった{問題|もんだい}が{起|お}きた。
{地震|じしん}を{想定|そうてい}した{避難|ひなん}{訓練|くんれん}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: An evacuation drill assuming an earthquake was carried out.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word frequently used in news, business, and official documents. The noun form {想定|そうてい} is also very common: {想定|そうてい}{外|がい} (beyond expectations) became widely known after the 2011 earthquake and nuclear disaster.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {想定|そうてい}{外|がい}: beyond assumptions, unexpected
- {想定|そうてい}{内|ない}: within expectations
- ～を{想定|そうてい}した{訓練|くんれん}: drill assuming ~
- {想定|そうてい}される{被害|ひがい}: anticipated damage
